name: io.github.TMHSDigital/screencast-mcp
title: Screencast MCP
description: Let AI agents record the Windows screen, watch it as frames, and edit it with ffmpeg

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCAST_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where recordings, frames, screenshots, and edits are written (default <homedir>/.screencast-mcp)

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCAST_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated folders outputs may be written to besides SCREENCAST_HOME; when set (or when the client sends roots), outputs elsewhere are refused

environmentVariables.name: FFMPEG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to ffmpeg if it is not on PATH (ffmpeg and ffprobe are required)

environmentVariables.name: FFPROBE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to ffprobe if it is not on PATH

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCAST_WHISPER_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: whisper.cpp model file (ggml-*.bin) used by transcribe when a call passes no model

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCAST_MAX_RECORDING_SEC
environmentVariables.description: Default recording cap in seconds when a call sets no maxDurationSec (default 3600; 0 disables it)

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCAST_JOB_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Override the edit job timeout in milliseconds (default scales with the media length)

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCAST_RETENTION_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: At startup, delete screenshots, frames, and leftover raw event logs older than this many days (never recordings or edits; off by default)

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCAST_PS_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Limit in milliseconds for the PowerShell helpers that list monitors and windows and run OCR (default 20000; OCR 60000)

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCAST_CONFIRM_CAPTURE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to ask the user to confirm every live capture through MCP elicitation; clients without elicitation are refused (off by default)

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCAST_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to load: capture, watch, edit, produce, audio (doctor and get_media_info are always on; default all)
